description: In-App Article Reader Mode: Fetch and display news article content directly in terminal instead of opening browser. Reader mode strips ads/navigation and renders clean, readable text. Essential for headless/server environments and reduces eye strain from bright browser windows.
principles: Rock-solid quality over speed - every feature must be bulletproof before moving on
Comprehensive test coverage - unit tests, integration tests, edge cases
All tests must pass before a story is marked complete
No story is done until it's documented and tested
Graceful degradation - if article extraction fails, fall back to browser
Respect user's time - show loading state, handle timeouts gracefully
Apply learnings from AGENTS.md - Rich markup for colors, explicit widget heights

CRITICAL_RENDERING_NOTES.warning: READ THIS BEFORE ANY WIDGET/RENDERING WORK
CRITICAL_RENDERING_NOTES.textual_colors: Textual uses Rich markup, NOT ANSI escape codes!
CRITICAL_RENDERING_NOTES.wrong_syntax: \033[32m (ANSI codes will BREAK rendering in Textual widgets)
CRITICAL_RENDERING_NOTES.label_markup: When Label contains Rich markup, you MUST set markup=True
CRITICAL_RENDERING_NOTES.markdown_rendering: Use Rich's Markdown class or Textual's Markdown widget for article content

techStack.httpClient: httpx (async) or aiohttp for non-blocking fetches

motivation: Headless/server environments have no display for browser
Bright browser windows cause eye strain in dark terminal workflow
Context switching to browser breaks focus
Many news sites have heavy ads/popups that degrade experience
Terminal-native reading keeps user in their workflow

currentBehavior.newsPanel: NewsPanel displays headlines, source, relative time, optional summary
currentBehavior.enterKey: Pressing Enter on selected article calls webbrowser.open(url)
currentBehavior.browserEvent: Posts NewsPanel.BrowserOpening message, app shows status
currentBehavior.dataAvailable: NewsItem has: title, source, url, published_at, summary

targetBehavior.enterKey: Pressing Enter opens article in ArticleReaderPanel (in-app)
targetBehavior.readerPanel: Full-screen scrollable panel with extracted article text
targetBehavior.escapeKey: Pressing Escape returns to news list

userStories.title: Create ArticleReader service for content extraction
acceptanceCriteria: New file: viper/services/article_reader.py
Add trafilatura to dependencies (pyproject.toml)
ArticleResult dataclass: title, content, author, date, source_url, word_count
ArticleError dataclass for error handling
async fetch_article(url: str) -> ArticleResult | ArticleError

100% test coverage on new module
userStories.notes: Service layer only - no UI. Focus on reliable extraction with good error messages. Test with real URLs during development but mock in tests.

userStories.title: Create ArticleReaderPanel widget
acceptanceCriteria: New file: viper/widgets/article_reader_panel.py
ArticleReaderPanel extends Textual Widget
Displays: title (bold), author/source, date, word count, reading time estimate
Main content area: scrollable, word-wrapped article text
Uses Rich Markdown rendering for formatted content
Loading state with spinner while fetching
Error state with descriptive message and 'press o to open in browser' hint
Keybindings: Escape/q (close), j/k (line scroll), PageUp/PageDown (page scroll), Home/End (top/bottom), o (open in browser), r (retry)
Green-on-black theme consistent with app
CSS styling in viper.tcss for article-reader-panel
Unit tests for widget states (loading, content, error)
Test scroll behavior and keybindings
userStories.notes: Panel should feel like a focused reading mode. Minimal chrome, maximum content. Consider showing progress indicator (e.g., '3 min read').

Add new keybinding 'o' to NewsPanel for 'open in browser' (old behavior)
NewsPanel posts ArticleOpenRequested message with selected NewsItem
App.py handles ArticleOpenRequested: shows ArticleReaderPanel
ArticleReaderPanel added to app layout (initially hidden)
When reader opens: hide news panel, show reader panel, fetch article
When reader closes (Escape): hide reader, show news panel, restore selection
Update help_screen.py with new keybindings:
- KEYBINDINGS section: Change Enter description to 'Read article / Select item'

- NEWS section: Update 'Enter to open in browser' -> 'Enter to read in terminal'

- Add new ARTICLE READER section after NEWS with all reader keybindings
- ARTICLE READER: Esc/q=close, j/k=scroll line, PageUp/Down=scroll page, Home/End=top/bottom, o=browser, r=retry

Integration tests: news -> reader -> back to news flow
Test that 'o' still opens browser correctly
userStories.notes: Key UX change - Enter now means 'read' not 'open browser'. Users who want browser use 'o'. This matches vim-style muscle memory.

userStories.title: Error handling and fallback behavior
acceptanceCriteria: If article extraction fails, show error in reader with clear message
Error panel offers 'press o to try opening in browser'
Handle specific errors: timeout, paywall detected, empty content, network error
Paywall detection: if content suspiciously short or contains paywall keywords
Add retry logic: user can press 'r' to retry fetch
Cache extracted articles for session (avoid re-fetching on back/forward)
Cache uses URL as key, expires after 30 minutes
Test all error scenarios with mocked responses
Test cache hit/miss behavior
userStories.notes: Graceful degradation is key. Never leave user stuck - always offer browser fallback.
